description: A wide 16:9 architecture diagram of a decoder-only transformer language model, drawn bottom to top in the centre, with short annotations on the right. Labels as plain text, no brackets. BOTTOM: a row of 6 small rounded token boxes reading exactly 'Kavita', ' needs', ' 2', '0', ' gaskets', ' before'. Above them a wide box 'Token embedding + position'. Above that, one large rounded rectangle with a soft sky-blue outline, labelled on its left side 'Transformer block' and on its right side '× 24'. Inside the block, from bottom to top: a thin box 'Norm', then a box 'Multi-head attention' (sky-blue fill), then a small circle with a plus sign labelled 'add', then a thin box 'Norm', then a box 'MLP' (light green fill), then a second small circle with a plus sign labelled 'add'. A straight vertical line on the left side of the block skips around each sub-layer into each plus circle, labelled 'residual stream'. Above the block: a thin box 'Final norm', then a box 'Unembedding: one score per token', then a box 'Softmax', and at the very top a small bar chart of five bars labelled ' run' 0.42, ' season' 0.21, ' rush' 0.08, ' festival' 0.06, ' order' 0.03, titled 'next token probabilities'. On the right, four short grey annotations aligned with their parts: 'each token becomes a vector of 896 numbers' beside the embedding, 'tokens look at earlier tokens' beside attention, 'each token is processed on its own' beside MLP, '151,936 scores, one per token in the vocabulary' beside the unembedding. Thin dark-grey arrows point upward between every stage.

A wide 16:9 left-to-right diagram with three large rounded stage panels connected by thick arrows, then a final small panel. Labels as plain text, no brackets. PANEL 1 title 'Pretraining'. Inside: a tall stack of many thin grey document sheets labelled 'trillions of tokens of public text: web pages, books, code', and under it a line 'game: predict the next token', and 'result: a base model that continues text'. PANEL 2 title 'Instruction tuning'. Inside: three small chat cards, each with a short grey line labelled 'question' and a sky-blue line labelled 'good answer', and under them 'tens of thousands of example conversations', 'result: a model that answers'. PANEL 3 title 'Preference tuning (RLHF)'. Inside: one question card with two answer cards side by side labelled 'answer A' and 'answer B', a green tick on answer A labelled 'people prefer A', and under them 'reward the preferred kind of answer', 'result: a helpful, polite assistant'. FINAL small panel on the far right with a padlock outline, titled 'Frozen', text 'weights fixed on the training date', 'never saw Rasoi's stock'. Under the whole row, a thin timeline arrow labelled 'training data ends here' pointing to the boundary before the Frozen panel.

A wide 16:9 diagram of the text generation loop as a clockwise cycle of five rounded boxes around a central label. Labels as plain text, no brackets. Box 1 at left: 'Text so far' containing the monospace example 'Kavita needs 20,000 gaskets before the Diwali'. Box 2 top: 'Tokenizer' with a short strip of token chips. Box 3 right: 'Transformer' (sky-blue fill). Box 4 bottom right: 'Probabilities for the next token' with a tiny bar chart. Box 5 bottom left: 'Pick one token' with the subtitle 'temperature, top-p'. An arrow from box 5 back to box 1 labelled 'append ' run' and repeat'. In the centre of the cycle, the text 'one token per turn of the loop'. Thin dark-grey arrows, generous whitespace.

A wide 16:9 diagram with two parts, left and right. Labels as plain text, no brackets. LEFT part titled 'What you send': three stacked rounded message cards, the first green-tinted labelled 'system' with text 'You are Ask Rasoi ...', the second grey labelled 'user' with text 'How many 5-litre silicone gaskets do we have in Pune stores?', the third sky-blue labelled 'assistant' with text 'We currently have 1,420 units ...'. A thick arrow points right labelled 'chat template'. RIGHT part titled 'What the model reads': one long horizontal ribbon of small token chips wrapping over three lines, with special marker chips in darker sky blue reading exactly '<|im_start|>system', '<|im_end|>', '<|im_start|>user', '<|im_end|>', '<|im_start|>assistant' interleaved with plain text chips. Around the ribbon a large dashed rounded rectangle labelled 'context window: everything the model can see at once'. Under the ribbon a small note 'one long sequence of tokens; the model continues it'.

A wide 16:9 diagram showing a gap between two worlds. Labels as plain text, no brackets. LEFT: a large sky-blue rounded panel titled 'What the model learned' containing a cloud of short grey phrases: 'how stock answers sound', 'units', 'Pune', 'gaskets', 'warehouse', 'inventory log', and a small label 'public text, frozen at training'. RIGHT: a large ember-orange rounded panel titled 'Bahi ERP 7.2' with a database cylinder labelled 'stock' and a small table row reading 'GSK-SIL-05L   Pune main stores   54,000'. BETWEEN them, an empty gap with a dashed broken line and the label 'no connection'. ABOVE the gap, a speech card from the left panel reading 'We currently have 1,420 units' with a small ember cross. BELOW the gap, two green dashed bridge arrows from left to right, labelled 'Lecture 3: give it the facts' and 'Lecture 4: let it look things up'.
